issues.name: Depressed Frontoparietal Skull Fracture
issues.icd10: S02.0XXA - Fracture of Vault of Skull
issues.symptoms: GCS 8, left hemiparesis, right pupil dilated and sluggish.
issues.intervention: Emergency decompressive craniectomy with 3D AR bone fragment tracking.

issues.name: Right Flail Chest & Tension Pneumothorax
issues.symptoms: Paradoxical chest motion, acute respiratory distress, tracheal shift.
issues.intervention: Immediate tube thoracostomy followed by AR-guided rib plating.

issues.name: Splenic Laceration Grade IV with Hemoperitoneum
issues.symptoms: Kehr's sign (left shoulder pain), hypotension (BP 82/50), FAST exam positive.
issues.intervention: Exploratory laparotomy vs. splenic artery angioembolization under 3D vascular roadmapping.

issues.name: Unstable Open-Book Pelvic Ring Fracture
issues.symptoms: Pelvic instability on gentle compression, retroperitoneal hematoma.
issues.intervention: Emergent pelvic binder stabilization followed by percutaneous sacroiliac screw fixation.

issues.name: Comminuted Distal Femur Fracture
issues.icd10: S72.401A - Comminuted Fracture of Lower End of Femur
issues.symptoms: Gross shortening and rotational deformity of right lower extremity.
issues.intervention: Retrograde intramedullary nailing with AR distal locking alignment.
